commands.title: kubectl: logs for <pod> in <namespace>
commands.description: Follow the last 200 log lines of a pod.

commands.title: kubectl: exec into <pod> in <namespace>
commands.description: Open a shell in a running pod. Many distroless images have no shell.

commands.title: kubectl: list pods not running
commands.description: Every pod in the cluster that is not in the Running phase.

commands.title: kubectl: decode a secret key
commands.description: Prints the secret value to your terminal. Mind your scrollback and screen sharing.
